hypotheses.justification: This follows from hpol and the checked fields of PolarisedAbelianScheme. Since Spec k has one point, hpol gives a global isomorphism σ* u.pol ≅ u.pol. The definitions of pol_isInvertible and pol_veryAmple make u.pol a very ample line bundle. Also, u.bundle makes u.A smooth, proper and connected over k, hence integral and normal. The proper endomorphism σ.1 is quasi-finite: on any positive-dimensional proper fibre its pullback line bundle would be both ample and trivial, which is impossible. Thus it is finite, and dimension forces it to be surjective. Comparing leading coefficients of Hilbert polynomials using σ* u.pol ≅ u.pol gives deg σ = 1. A finite birational morphism onto a normal scheme is an isomorphism. This also covers dimension zero, where the Hilbert polynomial is a positive constant; emptiness is excluded by the group-law unit section. Derive hσiso this way, then use the existing proof unchanged.
